Root cause is lines 110-111 forcing send_dummy on divider write.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picosoc/simpleuart.v b/picosoc/simpleuart.v

+++ b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
@@ -110,2 +110,0 @@
-		if (reg_div_we)
-			send_dummy <= 1;
", "expected": "tohost PASS 0x1 (was FAIL 0xdead), uart loopback 0xa5 matched with no TRAP uart data mismatch"}

diagnosis: Loopback send of 0xa5 was received as 0xff (idle) with TRAP uart data mismatch got 0xff want 0xa5. ser_tx/send_pattern advanced 16x too fast because line 130 compares send_divcnt to (cfg_divider >> 4) instead of cfg_divider while send_bitcnt shifts. With divider 64 the TX bit period is ~4 cycles vs expected 64, so the receiver never samples valid start/data bits.
expected: tohost PASS (not FAIL 0xdead), TRAP uart data mismatch gone, loopback got 0xa5 want 0xa5, checksum changes from e251d79bc7250f734efe026d9d7f036e818ad243c9428000f5cdb2c1fd8b03c6
